Candidate Reports
Candidate Filing for the 2026 Elections is closed. The deadline was June 2, 2026. Candidate filing deadline for the State Senate District 18 Vacancy Election closed on September 4, 2026.
Updates to the Candidate Report will include changes to candidate status and contact information.
